description: <name>!  Bink, my gnome colleague in Ironforge, sends word.  She has a task that needs doing and won't rely on anyone but a mage to do it!  Are you that mage, <name>?
If so, then speak with Bink.  She spends her time in the Hall of Mysteries in the Mystic Ward of Ironforge.
completion: Oh, I can see you have promise, yes you do! But it takes more than promise to be a good mage.  And if you're not a good mage, then you're a bad mage.  And bad mages are part of the problem, yes they are!
Oops, I'm getting ahead of things.  Let's begin at the start!
